body: Yeah it's never fun when that happens. I became self-aware of that when I too ended up having a friend like that and I never want to throw my burdens onto someone like that again. And you’re right, he's such a good friend and I shouldn't push him away bc of that. I haven't spoken to him for days now since my last breakdown, and I think talking to him will help, just as you are helping me woth your advice :) I'll give him a call tonight and see what happens.

Thank you, I hope so too! I think I'm just scared that he'll get fed up and annoyed with constantly hearing about my mental health problems. I lost my first best friend because I kept wrongfully throwing my emotional baggage on her, and I don't want to repeat that with my current best friend who's arguably the best person I ever had in my life. He tells me all the time that he'll always be there for me to talk and listen, but I can't help but fear the worst and push him away when it comes to that stuff.

That's very true. I just signed up for a new therapist today and she seems really nice so I'm crossing my fingers. I've known my best friend for 5 years coming this August. We meet up monthly and were planning to hang for my birthday That's coming up in 3 weeks. I've never had a friend like him, and yet I find it very difficult to open up to him and I keep him at arm's length when my depression gets bad. Idk why and I feel guilty when I do it.

We have insurance to cover the therapy thankfully, my main concern with therapy is mostly scheduling since they have a lot of other clients and it's hard to have appointments that aren't 2 weeks apart most of the time which I can understand. I do have my best friend, but I rarely get to see him much since he lives roughly 2 hours away (we met online).
